capabilities: Collect editor right-click menu items into a settings checklist
Hide any built-in, plugin-added or submenu item
Pin any command from Obsidian or installed plugins to the top of the menu
Toggle a separator between pinned commands and native items
Switch the settings interface between Chinese and English
disambiguation: Not a tool for building new context menus; it only hides existing editor menu items and pins commands to the top of that menu.
extras: Items are matched by their displayed label in the current Obsidian UI language, so after switching languages they must be collected and hidden again; items are only collected once they have actually been shown in the menu.
problem: Obsidian's editor right-click menu keeps growing with built-in items, entries added by other plugins and nested submenus, while commands used daily stay buried in the command palette.
summary: Settings tab that collects the editor right-click menu's items so you can hide them, and pins any command to the top of the menu.
